records.title: Heterogeneous catalytic ozonation of ciprofloxacin in aqueous solution using a manganese-modified silicate ore
records.summary: The authors studied ciprofloxacin ozonation in water using manganese-modified silicate ore. Their scavenger experiments were interpreted as evidence for hydroxyl-radical involvement.

records.title: Catalytic ozonation mechanism over M1-N3C1 active sites
records.summary: The authors investigated single-atom sites for ozone and methyl mercaptan removal from air. This gas-phase study is not direct evidence for aqueous catalytic ozonation.
